turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Wednesday. How is your day starting out in Phoenix? Have you had a chance to practice any Italian yet today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! No Italian yet, my morning was a bit too rushed for studying. But I did treat myself to a homemade drink before heading out. I whisked up some of that finely ground green tea powder with some warm oat milk to make a creamy, earthy latte.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a lovely, peaceful way to start a busy day. Did you skip using your roommate's new espresso machine today then? And how was the trip to the outpatient clinic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did skip the espresso today, wanted a different kind of caffeine boost. As for the trip, I ended up driving my hybrid car in. Phoenix traffic was actually pretty light for a Wednesday, so it was a very smooth ride.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A smooth commute is always a win! How have things been going at the clinic today? Are you on a busy shift?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's been steady, but manageable. I have a quick break right now. Tom and I were actually texting earlier about some potential ideas for our summer 2028 wedding, so my mind has been wandering a bit to that.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, how exciting! Have you both started looking at specific venues around Phoenix, or are you still in the early brainstorming phase?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mostly brainstorming! We're trying to decide if we want an indoor venue with air conditioning—since Phoenix summers are so hot—or if we should look at something else. We're not in a rush, but it's fun to talk about.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Defeating that desert heat is definitely a top priority! It's great that you have plenty of time to figure it all out. Aside from wedding brainstorming, have you been doing any sourdough baking lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually baked a couple of loaves over the weekend. I fed my starter on Friday night and spent Saturday working on the dough. It turned out really well, with a great crust. Tom loved it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! There really is nothing like fresh, homemade sourdough. I hope the rest of your shift goes smoothly today, Sofia.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm about to head back to the floor now. I'll talk to you later!
